content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Swift Mode Technical Information ## slug: swift-mode-technical-information ## seoTitle: Swift Mode Technical Information ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## “Mobile Check In Submission” Object and Fields The {{variable.Feature_SwiftMode}} feature includes the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} object called “{{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}},” which stores JSON received from the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}}. ### Object: Mobile Check In Submission * Object Label: {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} * API Name: conference360__Mobile_Check_In_Submission__c * Description: Captures and tracks {{variable.Object_Attendee}} check-in submissions from the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}}, including payload data, sync status, and error handling information. #### Permissions To access this object/record, users must have the same permissions as those required to access the {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} object/fields. * Read, Create, Edit, Delete * Blackthorn | Events (Admin) * Blackthorn | Events (Organizer) * Blackthorn | Events (Community/Platform User) * Read Only * Blackthorn | Events (Limited Access) * Blackthorn | Events (Lite User) * Blackthorn | Events (Read Only) * No Access * Blackthorn | Events (Community Guest User) #### Fields * Field Label: {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_AttendeesJSON}} * API Name: conference360__Attendees_JSON__c * Data Type: Long Text Area (131072) * Description: Stores the attendee payload sent by the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}} * Help Text: Full JSON payload containing attendee information sent from the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}}. Used for processing and verification. * Field Label: {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Status}} * API Name: conference360__Status__c * Data Type: Picklist * To Process * Completed * Partially Failed * Failed * Description: Represent the submission status at the given moment * Help Text: Indicates the current processing state of the submission: To Process, Completed, Partially Failed, or Failed. * Field Label: {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_RequestId}} * API Name: conference360__Attendees_JSON__c * Data Type: Long Text Area (131072) * Description: Stores the attendee payload sent by the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}} * Help Text: Unique ID generated by the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}} to associate the check-in request with a batch submission. * Field Label: {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_ChunkKey}} * API Name: conference360__Chunk_Key__c * Data Type: Text (255) (Unique Case Sensitive) * Description: Stores a unique identifier representing a small chunk of a sync request * Help Text: Unique identifier for a specific chunk of data during a batch sync. Reserved for system and internal use. * Field Label: {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Errors}} * API Name: conference360__Errors__c * Data Type: Long Text Area (131072) * Description: Stores detailed error messages if the sync or processing fails. * Help Text: Captures error details when a sync or attendee data processing attempt fails. Used for troubleshooting and support purposes. ### Scheduled and Batch Jobs #### ProcessCheckInSubmissionsBatch Batch Job The ProcessCheckInSubmissionsBatch batch job retrieves any {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} records related to a {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_RequestId}} that has not yet been processed and processes the information sent during the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}} sync. Before completing the process, the job will update the {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}}’s {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Status}} field as follows: * If all {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} records in the group are processed correctly, the {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Status}} field will be set to “Completed,” and the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records will be created or updated as expected. * If some of the {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} records in the group are processed correctly but others fail, the {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Status}} field will be set to “Partially Failed,” and the Errors field will include an error message. Only the successful {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records will be created or updated. * If all {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} records in the group fail to process correctly, the {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Status}} field will be set to “Failed,” and the Errors field will include an error message. NOTE: To avoid hitting Salesforce Governor Limits, a “soft” limit of 100 {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records per single {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} record is in place. #### “Blackthorn | Mobile Check-In Submissions Clean Up” Scheduled Job * Scheduled Job: Blackthorn | Mobile Check-In Submissions Clean Up * Apex Job: CheckInSubmissionCleanUpBatch * Frequency: The batch job runs on the first day of each month. * Click the **Schedule Recommended Event Jobs** button under Scheduled Jobs on the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab to schedule the Blackthorn | Mobile Check-In Submissions Clean Up job. After the {{variable.Feature_SwiftMode}} sync occurs, the “Blackthorn | Mobile Check-In Submissions Clean Up” scheduled job will run to remove irrelevant records created during check-in. The job queries the {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} records, looking for records that meet the following criteria, and deletes them. * The {{variable.Object_MobileCheckInSubmission}} record’s {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Status}} is set to “Completed,” “Partially Failed,” or “Failed.” * The record’s creation date is more than 365 days ago. NOTE: Records with the {{variable.Field_MobCkInSub_Status}} set to “To Process,” and the creation date within the last 365 days will not be deleted.
